content.text: No restriction on Customer's business exists; § 12.3 expressly confirms the preferred position.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us. § 12.3 affirmatively confirms we are free to develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier and conduct business in any field or territory, and that we have given no exclusivity or non-compete commitment; § 2.1 confirms no minimum purchase commitment. The only competition restraint (§ 12.4) binds Vendor, not us, and so is not flagged. The acceptable-use limits in § 13.4 (reverse engineering, interference, security bypass) are ordinary licence-scope terms, not field-of-use or competitive restraints. This meets the preferred position; no fallback narrowing is needed and no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
